# Understand the Game. Make Better Decisions.

Come with a question. Leave with a clear mental model you can use at the board.

Backgammon Made Simple uses real positions, practical decisions, clear explanations, mathematics, and engine evidence to make difficult ideas easier to understand.

## Featured: Sage vs GNU

:::: {.bms-callout}
::: {.bms-callout-title}
Original engine research
:::

What happens when Backgammon Sage and GNU Backgammon play controlled, mirrored matches—and then both sides are analyzed under the same process?

The Sage vs GNU project documents the match design, validation, analysis, results, uncertainty, and the positions where the engines disagree. Early studies are presented as evidence to examine, not as proof that one engine is universally stronger.

[See the Sage vs GNU Project](sage-vs-gnu/index.qmd){.bms-button-primary}
::::

## An Early Site, Built in Public

Backgammon Made Simple is being released before every lesson and tool is finished.

What is here should be honest and useful. What is still being built should be described plainly. The goal is not to fill the navigation with empty pages; it is to publish worthwhile explanations, working tools, and reproducible research as they become ready.

[About the Project](about.qmd){.bms-button-outline}
